+"""Failure accounting and backend attribution for the SE benchmark tools."""
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L0
+BENCH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "benchmark/causal_conv1d_se"
+
+
+def _load(name):
+    """Load a benchmark entry point without executing its command-line main."""
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(f"se_tool_{name}", BENCH / f"{name}.py")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def tool_tree(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Provide a tiny source snapshot and GPU identity for host-only orchestration tests."""
+    bench = tmp_path / "benchmark/causal_conv1d_se"
+    bench.mkdir(parents=True)
+    kernels = tmp_path / "python/cudnn/causal_conv1d_se"
+    kernels.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name in ("kernel.py", "backward_kernel.py", "b2b_kernel.py"):
+        (kernels / name).write_text("# frozen test source\n")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "get_device_name", lambda: "test GPU")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "get_device_capability", lambda: (9, 0))
+    return bench
+
+
+def test_controlled_timeout_is_recorded_and_sweep_continues(tool_tree, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Keep timeout output and execute subsequent jobs instead of losing the sweep summary."""
+    tool = _load("controlled_matrix")
+    tool.__file__ = str(tool_tree / "controlled_matrix.py")
+    case = dict(family="ncw", dtype="float32", shape=[1, 8, 17], width=3, silu=True, directions=["forward", "backward"])
+    (tool_tree / "supplemental_workloads.json").write_text(json.dumps({"cases": [case]}))
+    output = tmp_path / "results"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", [tool.__file__, "--supplement", "--output", str(output), "--backend-library", "unused.so"])
+    calls = []
+
+    def run(command, **kwargs):
+        """Time out the first direction and complete the second one."""
+        calls.append(command)
+        if len(calls) == 1:
+            raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(command, 900, output=b"partial status 3010\n", stderr=b"partial error\n")
+        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout="completed\n", stderr="")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(tool.subprocess, "run", run)
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as error:
+        tool.main()
+    assert error.value.code == 1
+    records = json.loads((output / "summary.json").read_text())["results"]
+    assert [r["status"] for r in records] == ["failed", "pass"]
+    assert [r["returncode"] for r in records] == [124, 0]
+    assert len(calls) == 2
+    assert (output / "000-forward.log").read_text() == "partial status 3010\nTimed out after 900 seconds\npartial error\n"
+
+
+def test_b2b_backward_rejection_is_backend_unsupported(tool_tree, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Classify the backward status-3010 spelling without failing the remaining sweep jobs."""
+    tool = _load("controlled_matrix")
+    tool.__file__ = str(tool_tree / "controlled_matrix.py")
+    cases = [
+        dict(family="b2b", dtype="float64", shape=[1, 8, 17], width=3, mixer_width=4, silu=False, directions=["forward", "backward"]),
+        dict(family="nwc", dtype="bfloat16", shape=[2, 768, 4096], width=4, silu=True, directions=["forward"]),
+    ]
+    manifest = tool_tree / "supplemental_workloads.json"
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"cases": cases}))
+    output = tmp_path / "results"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", [tool.__file__, "--supplement", "--output", str(output), "--backend-library", "unused.so"])
+
+    def run(command, **kwargs):
+        """Return a backward admission rejection only for fused backward."""
+        config = json.loads(Path(command[command.index("--case") + 1]).read_text())["args"]
+        fused = "projection_width" in config and command[command.index("--direction") + 1] == "backward"
+        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 1 if fused else 0, stdout="", stderr="backend backward status 3010" if fused else "")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(tool.subprocess, "run", run)
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as error:
+        tool.main()
+    assert error.value.code == 0
+    records = json.loads((output / "summary.json").read_text())["results"]
+    assert [r["status"] for r in records] == ["pass", "backend_unsupported", "pass"]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("selection", ["missing", "different", "ambiguous", "replaced", "matching_symlink"])
+def test_loaded_backend_library_identity(selection, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Reject false attribution, accepting an alias only when the loaded file identity matches."""
+    import hashlib
+    import os
+
+    tool = _load("backend")
+    loaded = tmp_path / "libcudnn_ext.so.9"
+    loaded.write_bytes(b"loaded backend")
+    other = tmp_path / "other/libcudnn_ext.so.9"
+    other.parent.mkdir()
+    other.write_bytes(b"other backend")
+    alias = tmp_path / "backend.so"
+    alias.symlink_to(loaded)
+    stat = loaded.stat()
+    device = f"{os.major(stat.st_dev):x}:{os.minor(stat.st_dev):x}"
+    inode = stat.st_ino + (selection == "replaced")
+    mappings = f"0000-1000 r-xp 00000000 {device} {inode} {loaded}\n"
+    if selection == "ambiguous":
+        mappings += f"1000-2000 r-xp 00000000 {device} {other.stat().st_ino} {other}\n"
+    read_text = Path.read_text
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_text", lambda path, *args, **kwargs: mappings if str(path) == "/proc/self/maps" else read_text(path, *args, **kwargs))
+    requested = tmp_path / "missing.so" if selection == "missing" else (other if selection == "different" else alias)
+    if selection == "matching_symlink":
+        identity = tool.verify_loaded_library(requested, 92900)
+        assert identity == dict(
+            requested_path=str(loaded),
+            loaded_path=str(loaded),
+            sha256=hashlib.sha256(loaded.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            size_bytes=14,
+            frontend_backend_version=92900,
+        )
+    else:
+        with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError if selection == "missing" else RuntimeError):
+            tool.verify_loaded_library(requested, 92900)

+"""Replay every recorded regression, preserving compile costs and raw timings."""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import runpy
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+
+def worker(args):
+    import torch
+    import cutlass
+    from cutlass import cute
+    import tune
+    from backend import Backend
+
+    source = json.loads(args.evidence.read_text())
+    config = source["args"]
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    compile_records = []
+    dispatch_records = []
+    original_compile = cute.compile
+
+    def timed_compile(fn, *values, **kwargs):
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        result = original_compile(fn, *values, **kwargs)
+        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
+        compile_records.append({"function": getattr(fn, "__qualname__", type(fn).__name__), "seconds": elapsed})
+        return result
+
+    cute.compile = timed_compile
+    for direction in ("forward", "backward"):
+        original = getattr(Backend, direction)
+
+        def timed_dispatch(self, *values, _original=original, _direction=direction, **kwargs):
+            if any(r["direction"] == _direction for r in dispatch_records):
+                return _original(self, *values, **kwargs)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            start = time.perf_counter()
+            result = _original(self, *values, **kwargs)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            dispatch_records.append({"direction": _direction, "first_dispatch_seconds": time.perf_counter() - start})
+            return result
+
+        setattr(Backend, direction, timed_dispatch)
+
+    original_measure = tune.measure
+
+    def measured(functions, **kwargs):
+        # This range is also usable with nsys; all compilation precedes it.
+        if args.profile:
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.cuda.cudart().cudaProfilerStart()
+            for name, fn in functions.items():
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                torch.cuda.nvtx.range_push(name)
+                for _ in range(5):
+                    fn()
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                torch.cuda.nvtx.range_pop()
+            torch.cuda.cudart().cudaProfilerStop()
+        return original_measure(functions, **kwargs)
+
+    tune.measure = measured

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Account for every slower baseline case without discarding small regressions."""
+
+import argparse
+import collections
+import csv
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import random
+import statistics
+
+
+def interval(candidate, backend):
+    rng = random.Random(20261026)
+    n = len(candidate)
+    assert n == len(backend)
+    samples = []
+    for _ in range(5000):
+        indices = [rng.randrange(n) for _ in range(n)]
+        samples.append(statistics.median(candidate[i] for i in indices) / statistics.median(backend[i] for i in indices))
+    samples.sort()
+    return samples[125], samples[4874]
+
+
+def category(row):
+    if row["family"] == "b2b":
+        return "fused_forward_halo_reuse" if row["direction"] == "forward" else "fused_backward_recomputation"
+    if row["dtype"] == "float64":
+        return "short_fp64_tile_and_empty_halo"
+    if row["family"] == "nwc":
+        return "nwh_forward_register_tile" if row["direction"] == "forward" else "nwh_backward_pipeline_and_reduction"
+    if row["direction"] == "forward":
+        return "ncw_forward_tile"
+    if int(row["L"]) % 8:
+        return "ncw_backward_cooperative_tail"
+    return "ncw_backward_sequence_partition"
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--replay", action="append", required=True, help="smNN=directory")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    replay = dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in args.replay)
+    rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(args.baseline.open()) if float(r["candidate_us"]) > float(r["backend_us"])]
+    records, compile_records = [], []
+    for row in rows:
+        folder = Path(replay[row["cc"]]) / Path(row["evidence"]).stem
+        data = json.loads((folder / "timing.json").read_text())
+        values = data.get("results", data.get("timing"))
+        cname = row["schedule"]
+        bname = "backend_" + ("fwd" if row["direction"] == "forward" else "bwd") if row["family"] == "b2b" else "backend"
+        c, b = values[cname], values[bname]
+        assert row["kernel_sha256"] in data["sha256"].values(), (row, data["sha256"])
+        low, high = interval(c["samples_us"], b["samples_us"])
+        ratio = c["median_us"] / b["median_us"]
+        record = dict(row)
+        record.update(
+            category=category(row),
+            replay_candidate_us=c["median_us"],
+            replay_backend_us=b["median_us"],
+            replay_slowdown_percent=100 * (ratio - 1),
+            ratio_ci95_low=low,
+            ratio_ci95_high=high,
+            status="slower" if low > 1 else ("faster" if high < 1 else "unresolved_near_parity"),
+            replay_evidence=str(folder / "timing.json"),
+            replay_gpu=data["gpu"],
+        )
+        records.append(record)
+        compile_data = json.loads((folder / "compilation.json").read_text())
+        compile_records.append({"cc": row["cc"], "case": Path(row["evidence"]).stem, **compile_data})
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with (args.output / "regressions.csv").open("w") as f:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(records[0]))
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(records)

+        if cutlass.const_expr(masks[0] != masks[2]):
+            if position // 64 % 2 != 0:
+                mask = cutlass.Uint32(masks[2])
+        if cutlass.const_expr(shape[1] % 64 != 0 or shape[2] % 64 != 0):
+            if (channel // 64 + 1) * 64 > shape[2] or (position // 64 + 1) * 64 > shape[1]:
+                mask = cutlass.Uint32(masks[1])
+        bit = (position % (element_bits // 4)) * (128 // element_bits) + channel % (128 // element_bits)
+        if (mask >> bit) & 1:
+            value = cute.math.fma(g1, w1, g0 * w0)
+        else:
+            value = cute.math.fma(g0, w0, g1 * w1)
+    return value
+
+
+def _nwh_center_only(dtype, width, silu, shape):
+    from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import CuTeDSL
+
+    return CuTeDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum().major == 9 and dtype.width == 16 and width == 7 and not silu and shape[1] <= 256 and shape[2] >= 768
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def causal_conv1d_bwd_nwc_fused(
+    x: cute.Tensor,
+    w: cute.Tensor,
+    bias: cute.Tensor,
+    dy: cute.Tensor,
+    dx: cute.Tensor,
+    dw: cute.Tensor,
+    db: cute.Tensor,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    silu: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    rows: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """Recompute SiLU in registers and amortize parameter atomics across sequence chunks."""
+    channel = cute.arch.block_idx()[0] * 128 + cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    first = cute.arch.block_idx()[1] * rows
+    batch = cute.arch.block_idx()[2]
+    compute = dw.element_type
+    weights = cute.make_rmem_tensor((width,), compute)
+    dw_reg = cute.make_rmem_tensor((width,), compute)
+    window = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8 + 2 * width - 2,), compute)
+    grads = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8 + width - 1,), compute)
+    dw_reg.fill(0)
+    db_value = compute(0)
+    if channel < x.shape[2]:
+        bias_value = bias[channel].to(compute)
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+            weights[k] = w[k, channel].to(compute)
+        for chunk in cutlass.range(0, rows // 8, unroll=1):
+            start = first + chunk * 8
+            window.fill(0)
+            grads.fill(0)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8 + 2 * width - 2):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(not _nwh_center_only(x.element_type, width, silu, x.shape) or width - 1 <= i < width + 7):
+                    t = start - width + 1 + i
+                    if t >= 0 and t < x.shape[1]:
+                        window[i] = x[batch, t, channel].to(compute)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8 + width - 1):
+                if start + i < x.shape[1]:
+                    grad = dy[batch, start + i, channel].to(compute)
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(silu):
+                        value = bias_value
+                        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(not _nwh_seqpar(x.element_type, width, silu, x.shape)):
+                                value += window[i + width - 1 - k] * weights[width - 1 - k]
+                            else:
+                                value += window[i + k] * weights[k]
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(x.element_type.width == 16 and _nwh_seqpar(x.element_type, width, silu, x.shape)):
+                            sig = 0.5 + 0.5 * cute.tanh(0.5 * value, fastmath=True)
+                        else:
+                            sig = _sigmoid(value)
+                        grad *= sig * (1.0 + value * (1.0 - sig))
+                    grads[i] = grad
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                value = compute(0)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(
+                    (x.element_type == cutlass.Float32 or (x.element_type.width == 16 and not _uses_packed_nwh()))
+                    and _nwh_seqpar(x.element_type, width, silu, x.shape)
+                    and 1 < width <= 8
+                ):
+                    # NVRTC contracts the first two SE products with tap 1 rounded first.
+                    value = _nwh_first_pair(
+                        grads[i], weights[width - 1], grads[i + 1], weights[width - 2], channel, start + i, x.shape, width, x.element_type.width, silu
+                    )
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(2, width):
+                        value = cute.math.fma(grads[i + k], weights[width - 1 - k], value)
+                else:
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                        value += grads[i + k] * weights[width - 1 - k]
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                    dw_reg[width - 1 - k] += window[i + width - 1] * grads[i + k]
+                db_value += grads[i]
+                if start + i < x.shape[1]:
+                    dx[batch, start + i, channel] = value.to(dx.element_type)
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+            cute.arch.atomic_add(dw.iterator + cutlass.Int64(k) * x.shape[2] + channel, dw_reg[k])
+        cute.arch.atomic_add(db.iterator + channel, db_value)
+
+
+causal_conv1d_bwd_nwc_fused.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tail_load(x, batch, channel, tile, lane, compute: cutlass.Constexpr, scratch: cute.Tensor, halo: cutlass.Constexpr = 256):
+    values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+    values.fill(0)
+    warp = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] // 32
+    if tile >= 0:
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            pos = lane + i * 32
+            value = compute(0)
+            if pos >= 256 - cute.ceil_div(halo, 8) * 8 and tile * 256 + pos < x.shape[2]:
+                value = x[batch, channel, tile * 256 + pos].to(compute)
+            scratch[warp, pos ^ (pos >> 5)] = value
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            pos = lane * 8 + i
+            values[i] = scratch[warp, pos ^ (pos >> 5)]
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+    return values
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tail_store(y, batch, channel, start, values, scratch: cute.Tensor):
+    warp = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] // 32
+    lane = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % 32
+    tile_start = start - lane * 8
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        pos = lane * 8 + i
+        scratch[warp, pos ^ (pos >> 5)] = values[i]
+    cute.arch.sync_warp()
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        pos = lane + i * 32
+        if tile_start + pos < y.shape[2]:
+            y[batch, channel, tile_start + pos] = scratch[warp, pos ^ (pos >> 5)].to(y.element_type)
+    cute.arch.sync_warp()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ncw_load(x, batch, channel, tile, lane, compute: cutlass.Constexpr, scratch, halo: cutlass.Constexpr = 256):
+    if cutlass.const_expr(x.shape[2] % 8 != 0):
+        values = _tail_load(x, batch, channel, tile, lane, compute, scratch, halo)
+    else:
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+        values.fill(0)
+        if tile >= 0 and lane >= 32 - cute.ceil_div(halo, 8):
+            start = tile * 256 + lane * 8
+            if cutlass.const_expr(x.shape[2] % 8 == 0):
+                if start < x.shape[2]:
+                    atom = cute.make_copy_atom(cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), x.element_type, num_bits_per_copy=128)
+                    raw = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), x.element_type)
+                    offset = cutlass.Int64(batch) * x.stride[0] + cutlass.Int64(channel) * x.stride[1] + start
+                    view = cute.make_tensor((x.iterator + offset).align(16), cute.make_layout((8,)))
+                    cute.copy(atom, view, raw)
+                    values.store(raw.load().to(compute))
+            else:
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    if start + i < x.shape[2]:
+                        values[i] = x[batch, channel, start + i].to(compute)
+        return values
+    return values
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ncw_dz(x, w, weights, bias_value, dy, batch, channel, tile, lane, width: cutlass.Constexpr, silu: cutlass.Constexpr, compute: cutlass.Constexpr, scratch):
+    current = _ncw_load(x, batch, channel, tile, lane, compute, scratch)
+    original = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+    original.store(current.load())
+    grad = _ncw_load(dy, batch, channel, tile, lane, compute, scratch)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(silu):
+        if tile * 256 < x.shape[2]:
+            previous = _ncw_load(
+                x,
+                batch,
+                channel,
+                tile - 1,
+                lane,
+                compute,
+                scratch,
+                256 if x.shape[2] % 8 == 0 and x.shape[2] >= 1024 and not _is_sm86() else width - 1,
+            )
+            result = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+            result.fill(bias_value)
+            for tap in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(tap > 0):
+                    shifted = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(current[7], (lane + 31) % 32)
+                    halo = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(previous[7 - (tap - 1) % 8], 31 - (tap - 1) // 8)
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(7, 0, -1):
+                        current[i] = current[i - 1]
+                    current[0] = shifted
+                    if lane == 0:
+                        current[0] = halo
+                if cutlass.const_expr(width <= 16):
+                    weight = weights[width - 1 - tap]
+                else:
+                    weight = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(weights[(width - 1 - tap) // 32], (width - 1 - tap) % 32)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    result[i] += current[i] * weight
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                sig = _sigmoid(result[i])
+                grad[i] *= sig * (1.0 + result[i] * (1.0 - sig))
+    return original, grad
+
+
+def _is_sm86():
+    from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import CuTeDSL
+
+    arch = CuTeDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum()
+    return arch.major == 8 and arch.minor == 6
+
+
+def _ncw_batch_group(dtype, silu, shape):
+    from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import CuTeDSL
+
+    arch = CuTeDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum()
+    if arch.major != 8 or dtype != cutlass.Float32 or shape[2] > 256:
+        return 1
+    group = 1
+    if arch.minor == 9:
+        group = 32 if silu else 16
+    elif arch.minor == 6 and silu:
+        group = 8
+    return group if shape[0] % group == 0 else 1
+
+
+def _ncw_warps(dtype, shape, width):
+    from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import CuTeDSL
+
+    # Short K32 tiles need more independent CTAs on SM100/103, including additive gradients.
+    arch = CuTeDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum()
+    if arch.major == 10 and arch.minor in (0, 3) and dtype.width == 16 and width == 32 and shape[2] <= 256:
+        return 1
+    return 1 if (width >= 64 and shape[2] <= 256) or (_is_sm86() and dtype.width == 16 and shape[2] % 8 != 0) else 4
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def causal_conv1d_bwd_ncw_fused(
+    x: cute.Tensor,
+    w: cute.Tensor,
+    b: cute.Tensor,
+    dy: cute.Tensor,
+    dx: cute.Tensor,
+    dw: cute.Tensor,
+    db: cute.Tensor,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    silu: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tiles: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    warps: cutlass.Constexpr = _ncw_warps(x.element_type, x.shape, width)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    lane = tid % 32
+    blocks_s = cute.ceil_div(x.shape[2], 256 * tiles)
+    blocks_h = cute.ceil_div(x.shape[1], warps)
+    batch_group: cutlass.Constexpr = _ncw_batch_group(x.element_type, silu, x.shape)
+    block = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    if cutlass.const_expr(_is_sm86() and x.shape[2] <= 256 and not (silu and x.element_type == cutlass.Float32) and x.shape[0] <= 65535):
+        first = cute.arch.block_idx()[0] * tiles
+        channel = cute.arch.block_idx()[1] * warps + tid // 32
+        batch = cute.arch.block_idx()[2]
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(batch_group > 1):
+        first = (cute.arch.block_idx()[0] // batch_group) * tiles
+        channel = cute.arch.block_idx()[1] * warps + tid // 32
+        batch = cute.arch.block_idx()[2] * batch_group + cute.arch.block_idx()[0] % batch_group
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(silu and x.element_type == cutlass.Float32 and x.shape[2] <= 256):
+        batch = block % x.shape[0]
+        channel = (block // x.shape[0]) * warps + tid // 32
+        first = 0
+    else:
+        first = (block % blocks_s) * tiles
+        channel = (block // blocks_s % blocks_h) * warps + tid // 32
+        batch = block // (blocks_s * blocks_h)
+    compute = dw.element_type
+    scratch = None
+    if cutlass.const_expr(x.shape[2] % 8 != 0):
+        scratch = SmemAllocator().allocate_tensor(compute, cute.make_layout((warps, 256), stride=(256, 1)), byte_alignment=16)
+    distributed = width > 16
+    slots = cute.ceil_div(width, 32) if distributed else width
+    dw_reg = cute.make_rmem_tensor((slots,), compute)
+    dw_reg.fill(0)
+    db_value = compute(0)
+    weights = cute.make_rmem_tensor((cute.ceil_div(width, 32) if width > 16 else width,), compute)
+    if channel < x.shape[1]:
+        bias_value = b[channel].to(compute)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(width <= 16):
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                weights[k] = w[channel, k].to(compute)
+        else:
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.ceil_div(width, 32)):
+                k = group * 32 + lane
+                value = compute(0)
+                if k < width:
+                    value = w[channel, k].to(compute)
+                weights[group] = value
+        end = min(first + tiles, cute.ceil_div(x.shape[2], 256))
+        unused, following = _ncw_dz(x, w, weights, bias_value, dy, batch, channel, end, lane, width, silu, compute, scratch)
+        for reverse in cutlass.range(0, end - first, unroll=1):
+            tile = end - 1 - reverse
+            start = tile * 256 + lane * 8
+            original, current = _ncw_dz(x, w, weights, bias_value, dy, batch, channel, tile, lane, width, silu, compute, scratch)
+            keep = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+            keep.store(current.load())
+            result = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), compute)
+            result.fill(0)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                db_value += current[i]
+            for tap in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(tap > 0):
+                    shifted = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(current[0], (lane + 1) % 32)
+                    halo = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(following[(tap - 1) % 8], (tap - 1) // 8)
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+                        current[i] = current[i + 1]
+                    current[7] = shifted
+                    if lane == 31:
+                        current[7] = halo
+                if cutlass.const_expr(width <= 16):
+                    weight = weights[width - 1 - tap]
+                else:
+                    weight = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(weights[(width - 1 - tap) // 32], (width - 1 - tap) % 32)
+                grad = compute(0)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    result[i] += current[i] * weight
+                    grad += original[i] * current[i]
+                if cutlass.const_expr(distributed):
+                    for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                        grad += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(grad, 1 << offset)
+                    if lane == (width - 1 - tap) % 32:
+                        dw_reg[(width - 1 - tap) // 32] += grad
+                else:
+                    dw_reg[width - 1 - tap] += grad
+            following.store(keep.load())
+            if cutlass.const_expr(dx.shape[2] % 8 == 0):
+                if start < dx.shape[2]:
+                    raw = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), dx.element_type)
+                    raw.store(result.load().to(dx.element_type))
+                    atom = cute.make_copy_atom(cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), dx.element_type, num_bits_per_copy=128)
+                    offset = cutlass.Int64(batch) * dx.stride[0] + cutlass.Int64(channel) * dx.stride[1] + start
+                    view = cute.make_tensor((dx.iterator + offset).align(16), cute.make_layout((8,)))
+                    cute.copy(atom, raw, view)
+            else:
+                _tail_store(dx, batch, channel, start, result, scratch)
+        for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            db_value += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(db_value, 1 << offset)
+        if lane == 0:
+            cute.arch.atomic_add(db.iterator + channel, db_value)
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+            value = dw_reg[k]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(distributed):
+                if k * 32 + lane < width:
+                    cute.arch.atomic_add(dw.iterator + cutlass.Int64(channel) * width + k * 32 + lane, value)
+            else:
+                for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                    value += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, 1 << offset)
+                if lane == 0:
+                    cute.arch.atomic_add(dw.iterator + cutlass.Int64(channel) * width + k, value)
+
+
+causal_conv1d_bwd_ncw_fused.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _nwh_async_vector(src, dst, offset, target, valid, vector: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    safe = cutlass.Int64(0)
+    if valid:
+        safe = offset
+    layout = cute.make_layout((vector, 1), stride=(1, vector))
+    g = cute.make_tensor((src.iterator + safe).align(16), layout)
+    s = cute.make_tensor((dst.iterator + target).align(16), layout)
+    pred = cute.make_rmem_tensor((vector, 1), cutlass.Boolean)
+    pred.fill(valid)
+    atom = cute.make_copy_atom(cute.nvgpu.cpasync.CopyG2SOp(cache_mode=cute.nvgpu.common.LoadCacheMode.GLOBAL), src.element_type, num_bits_per_copy=128)
+    cute.copy(atom, g, s, pred=pred)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _nwh_stage(
+    x,
+    dy,
+    sx,
+    sy,
+    batch,
+    channel_start,
+    tile,
+    stage: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tile_s: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tile_h: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    threads: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    silu: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    vector = 128 // x.element_type.width
+    tpr = tile_h // vector
+    halo = width - 1
+    xr = tile_s + 2 * halo
+    yr = tile_s + halo
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    start = tile * tile_s
+    for index in cutlass.range(tid, xr * tpr, threads, unroll=1):
+        row = index // tpr
+        col = index % tpr * vector
+        pos = start - halo + row
+        valid = pos >= 0 and pos < x.shape[1] and channel_start + col < x.shape[2]
+        offset = cutlass.Int64(batch) * x.stride[0] + cutlass.Int64(pos) * x.stride[1] + channel_start + col
+        _nwh_async_vector(x, sx, offset, (stage * xr + row) * tile_h + col, valid, vector)
+    for index in cutlass.range(tid, yr * tpr, threads, unroll=1):
+        row = index // tpr
+        col = index % tpr * vector
+        pos = start + row
+        valid = pos < x.shape[1] and channel_start + col < x.shape[2]
+        offset = cutlass.Int64(batch) * dy.stride[0] + cutlass.Int64(pos) * dy.stride[1] + channel_start + col
+        _nwh_async_vector(dy, sy, offset, (stage * yr + row) * tile_h + col, valid, vector)
+    cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _nwh_load_vector(src, offset, vector: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    raw = cute.make_rmem_tensor((vector,), src.element_type)
+    view = cute.make_tensor((src.iterator + offset).align(16), cute.make_layout((vector,)))
+    atom = cute.make_copy_atom(cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), src.element_type, num_bits_per_copy=128)
+    cute.copy(atom, view, raw)
+    return raw
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _nwh_compute(
+    sx,
+    sy,
+    dx,
+    weights,
+    bias,
+    partial,
+    batch,
+    channel_start,
+    tile,
+    stage: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    silu: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tile_s: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tile_h: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    threads: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    vector = 128 // dx.element_type.width
+    tpr = tile_h // vector
+    rows = tile_s // (threads // tpr)
+    halo = width - 1
+    xr, yr = tile_s + 2 * halo, tile_s + halo
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    col = tid % tpr * vector
+    rbase = tid // tpr * rows
+    start = tile * tile_s
+    window = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((width, vector), stride=(vector, 1)), cutlass.Float32)
+    grads = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((rows + halo, vector), stride=(vector, 1)), cutlass.Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(halo):
+        raw = _nwh_load_vector(sx, (stage * xr + rbase + j) * tile_h + col, vector)
+        for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(vector):
+            window[j, v] = raw[v].to(cutlass.Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(rows + halo):
+        raw = _nwh_load_vector(sx, (stage * xr + rbase + j + halo) * tile_h + col, vector)
+        gy = _nwh_load_vector(sy, (stage * yr + rbase + j) * tile_h + col, vector)
+        for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(vector):
+            window[(j + halo) % width, v] = raw[v].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            grad = gy[v].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(silu):
+                z = bias[v]
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+                    z = cute.math.fma(window[(j + k) % width, v], weights[k, v], z)
+                sig = cutlass.Float32(0)

+def _reference(x, weight, bias, silu, nwh):
+    xx = x.transpose(1, 2) if nwh else x
+    ww = weight.T if nwh else weight
+    result = bias.double()[None, :, None].expand_as(xx).clone()
+    for k in range(ww.shape[1]):
+        shift = ww.shape[1] - 1 - k
+        if shift < xx.shape[2]:
+            result[:, :, shift:] += xx[:, :, : xx.shape[2] - shift].double() * ww[:, k].double()[None, :, None]
+    if silu:
+        result = torch.nn.functional.silu(result)
+    return result.transpose(1, 2) if nwh else result

+# CuTe DSL causal-convolution SE benchmarks
+
+Compare the NCW, NWH, and fused projection/mixer kernels in `python/cudnn/causal_conv1d_se` with the cuDNN SE backend through the frontend bindings. Dense BF16 NWH K4 SiLU cases also compare the existing frontend bulk implementation. These are low-level candidates; public operator routing is unchanged.
+
+The directory contains a fixed workload runner, its comparison/timing helpers, workload manifests, and result collectors. Correctness tests live in `test/python/causal_conv1d/cutedsl`. Historical performance and compilation measurements, optimization details, and remaining acceptance gaps are recorded in [PR #1945](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1945).
+
+## Contracts
+
+| Family | Input | Filters | Widths | Outputs |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| NCW | `[B,D,L]` contiguous | `[D,K]` | `2 <= K <= 256` | forward; `dx`, `dw`, `db` |
+| NWH / NWC | `[B,L,D]` contiguous | `[K,D]` | `2 <= K <= 128` | forward; `dx`, `dw`, `db` |
+| Back-to-back | `[B,3*D,L]` contiguous | projection `[3*D,Kp]`, mixer `[D,Km]` | `2 <= Kp <= 32`, `2 <= Km <= 256` | ungated and gated forward; `dx`, `dwp`, `dwm`, `dskip` |
+
+Inputs, filters, bias, and data outputs share one of FP16, BF16, FP32, or FP64. Parameter gradients use FP32 except for FP64 inputs, which use FP64 gradients. Bias is a required `[D]` tensor for NCW/NWH. These low-level kernels assume valid shapes, matching dtypes, dense storage, aligned vector accesses, and disjoint input/output buffers; they do not implement the frontend lifecycle's runtime validation.
+
+The last filter tap multiplies the current token. NCW/NWH support identity and SiLU. The back-to-back channel order is interleaved `(x1, x2, v)` for each feature. Its projections have no activation:
+
+```text
+p1 = causal_conv(x1, wp1)
+p2 = causal_conv(x2, wp2)
+pv = causal_conv(v, wpv)
+u = p2 * pv
+y = causal_conv(u, wm) + skip * u
+y_gated = p1 * y
+```
+
+Back-to-back backward receives the gradient of `y_gated` and uses the saved, input-dtype `y` for the gradient of `p1`, matching the backend ABI. It does not accept an independent gradient for the auxiliary `y` output. The mixer product and its previous-tile halo stay in the compute dtype, including non-vectorized sequence lengths.
+
+Parameter-gradient accumulation uses atomics and is not bitwise deterministic. The backward launchers reset parameter outputs by default. Compile with the final `accumulate=True` argument to preserve existing parameter gradients and add to them, matching the backend ABI. Data gradients are overwritten in either mode. The fused back-to-back kernels need no global intermediate workspace. Standard backward retains a caller-owned compute-dtype `dz` workspace for the wide-filter NWH path; the fused NCW and short-filter NWH paths do not use that workspace.
+
+The candidate launchers perform no allocation, tensor conversion, or synchronization. Compile outside capture and pass the active CUDA stream at execution. Full public API integration, including argument checks and architecture admission, is still required.
+
+## Existing API contracts and replacement scope
+
+The existing `causal_conv1d_bulk_sm100` package processes complete dense or packed sequences for prefill and training. +

+output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+names = ("kernel.py", "backward_kernel.py", "b2b_kernel.py")

Existing FE data outputs use `atol=rtol=0.03`, with raw-bit differences also retained; its parameter gradients use the same atomic-gradient contract.
+
+Device timing uses preallocated CUDA Graphs on the active stream, a warmup period, 100 kernel executions per sample, and 21 samples in randomized order. Compilation and allocation are excluded. Backend and candidate use identical output addresses; a backend A/A control records sensitivity to output placement. Overwrite timings include parameter clearing in both arms. Additive timings exclude clearing in both arms and validate accumulation from nonzero buffers. Raw samples and round positions are retained. Bootstrap intervals describe within-run sampling, not repeatability across machines, clocks, or cache layouts.
+
+Each result records candidate `cute.compile` wall time separately. This harness does not measure backend NVRTC compilation or the existing FE's full initialization/cache lifecycle; those require separate instrumentation. The historical three-way compiler study remains in the PR report.
+
+## Collect results
+
+Save the expected kernel hashes from the frozen source before starting a sweep:
+
+```bash
+"${CUDNN_FRONTEND_PYTHON_VENV:?}/bin/python" - <<'PYCODE'
+import hashlib, json, os
+from pathlib import Path
+root = Path("python/cudnn/causal_conv1d_se")
+output = Path(os.environ["SE_BENCH_RESULTS"])
+output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+names = ("kernel.py", "backward_kernel.py", "b2b_kernel.py")
+(output / "source-hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps({n: hashlib.sha256((root / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in names}))

- **Backend provenance:** `compare_variants.py` now rejects a missing requested library before GPU work. After the first untimed frontend call, it requires exactly one mapped SE library matching that file, checks the mapped device/inode against disk, and records the resolved path, SHA-256, size, and frontend-reported backend version. Missing, mismatched, ambiguous, and replaced libraries fail; symlink aliases are accepted when they identify the same file.
- **Fused result reuse:** the manifest requires positive, finite candidate and backend timings for both forward and backward. Untimed or incomplete probes are rerun with `--timing`.

Validation: 17 host regression tests pass. A100/CuTe DSL 4.8.0/cuDNN 9.29 with NVRTC 13.6: the reviewer's missing-library negative control and an existing-but-mismatched library both fail, while the matching-library comparison passes all three exact-data checks and emits library identity. Formatting/license checks pass. This is focused harness validation; the historical performance tables have not been remeasured.

GPU CI for the preceding head passed SM100 (all 171 SE tests); SM107 passed the broader suite but skipped all 165 SE GPU tests, so it does not establish SE support. The channel count is therefore 1032, which is divisible by eight. For both FP16/BF16 and both activation settings, [`_use_nwh_pipeline`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/4e194c26e0e8d644b5f2245064db5bfb2b889448/python/cudnn/causal_conv1d_se/backward_kernel.py#L991-L1006) selects the pipeline on the supported pre-SM120 targets. The test covers a sequence tail and a partial 64-channel tile through normal dispatch. SM120 intentionally uses another schedule. No forced launcher is needed for this finding; the four cases passed in the H100 suite.
